ex.en: How many times has Japan hosted the Olympics?
ex.zh: 日本辦過幾次奧運？

ex.en: Euro 2012 is being hosted jointly by Poland and Ukraine.
ex.zh: 2012 年歐洲盃足球賽由波蘭和烏克蘭共同主辦。

ex.en: The party host had a Portuguese accent.
ex.zh: 派對的主人說話帶著葡萄牙口音。

ex.en: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.
ex.zh: 客人不該喧賓奪主。

ex.en: We have to cope with hosts of difficulties.
ex.zh: 我們得應付許多困難。

ex.en: The new phone has a host of useful features.
ex.zh: 這支新手機有許多實用的功能。

ex.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
ex.zh: 所有客人都被她的熱情款待感動了。

ex.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality.
ex.zh: 謝謝您熱情的款待。

ex.en: She has worked in hospitality for ten years.
ex.zh: 她在餐旅服務業工作十年了。

ex.en: The hospitality industry was hit hard by the pandemic.
ex.zh: 餐旅業受疫情重創。

ex.en: The Algerians are a hospitable people.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞人是很好客的民族。

ex.en: The locals were very hospitable to us.
ex.zh: 當地人對我們非常熱情。

ex.en: Housekeeping will clean your room while you're out.
ex.zh: 你外出時，房務人員會打掃你的房間。

ex.en: Please call housekeeping if you need more towels.
ex.zh: 如果需要更多毛巾，請打電話給房務部。

ex.en: She has been in the hospital for a month.
ex.zh: 她已經住院一個月了。

ex.en: I went to the hospital to see my wife.
ex.zh: 我去醫院看我太太。

ex.en: How can I get to the hospital by bus?
ex.zh: 去醫院要搭哪一路公車？

ex.en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
ex.zh: 我弟弟手裡拿著一台相機。

ex.en: He was holding a large box in his arms.
ex.zh: 他用雙手抱著一個大箱子。

ex.en: Could you hold, please? I'll check for you.
ex.zh: 請稍等一下，我幫您查詢。

ex.en: I've been on hold for twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 我已經在線上等了二十分鐘。

ex.en: We will hold a meeting next Tuesday.
ex.zh: 我們下週二將召開會議。

ex.en: The festival is held every summer.
ex.zh: 這個節慶每年夏天舉行。
